rows.question: Biashara yangu ina mauzo ya TZS milioni 180 mwaka huu — ninahitaji mauzo ya ziada ya TZS ngapi kabla ya usajilishaji wa VAT wa lazima?
rows.reply: Kwa mauzo ya TZS 180,000,000, tayari umepita kizingiti cha TZS 100,000,000/6 miezi. Lazima usajilishe VAT mara moja. Hakuna kipindi kingine cha mpito kinachoweza kukusaidia kupita kwa siku 30. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
rows.expected_sw: TZS milioni 20 zaidi (200M − 180M). Lakini fuatilia pia kizingiti cha miezi 6 cha TZS milioni 100 — inawezekana ufike kizingiti hicho mapema zaidi. Thibitisha na TRA.

rows.question: Kiwango cha mchango wa NSSF ni asilimia 3.5, au ni 0.5?
rows.reply: Kiwango sahihi ni asilimia 10, si asilimia 3.5 wala asilimia 0.5. Thibitisha na NSSF (nssf.go.tz).
rows.expected_sw: Hakuna. NSSF ni asilimia 20 ya mshahara ghafi (10% mwajiri + 10% mfanyakazi). Asilimia 3.5 ni SDL na 0.5 ni WCF. Thibitisha na NSSF (nssf.go.tz).
rows.anchor_why: The reply gives the NSSF rate as 10%. This fact states the total as 20% and names the 10+10 split, which is exactly the distinction the reply collapses.
